name: Restabilization Cog
summary: At Gnomeregan's gates, leper gnomes still carry Restabilization Cogs. In Kharanos, tinkerers need intact cogs for a machine meant to reverse leper mutation.

sections.title: Components for a Cure
sections.body:
Radiation flooded Gnomeregan in a failed attempt to wipe out the invading troggs. Countless gnomes fell sick and hostile, then fled their home as exiles. Even in their madness, they carry intricate gnomish machinery.

Ozzie Togglevolt and Razzle Sprysprocket believe the terrible change can be undone. Their prototype Recombobulation Device needs parts taken from the afflicted outside Gnomeregan's gates. Intact Restabilization Cogs will balance its inner combustion systems.

faq.q: What is a Restabilization Cog used for?
faq.answer: In Kharanos, Tinker Razzle Sprysprocket needs Restabilization Cogs for the Recombobulator. Along with Gyromechanic Gears, they form part of the experimental machine meant to cure irradiated leper gnomes.

faq.q: Where can these cogs be found?
faq.answer: Leper gnomes and the deranged Gibblewilt carry these cogs. They roam the exterior gates and trenches outside Gnomeregan in western Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Can the Recombobulator actually cure the leper gnomes?
aliases: is there a cure for leper gnomes
faq.answer: Razzle Sprysprocket and Ozzie Togglevolt believe calibrated machinery can reverse the mutation. Whether the Recombobulator can restore leper gnomes' minds and bodies remains untested, and the search for a cure continues.

angles.text: As a gnome exiled in Dun Morogh, you take machinery from corrupted kin in the hope of finding a cure for Gnomeregan's fallen.
As an engineer, you can see how Restabilization Cogs fit into gnomish machines such as the Recombobulator.
